description: Player 2 deck for spec 29 (R383). This is spec 03 player 2 deck (03-sheepish-b) with #41 Sheepish swapped for C #5 Tesla. Tesla is then the only Trap or Field Trap in either deck, so the face-down card in player 2 backrow can only be Tesla. The deck already holds #62 Friend of Felinors, which fills player 2 unit row in the second test, so that Tesla has no unit zone to step into. Player 1 plays 03-plays-a. The other cards are spec 03 choice-free filler that player 2 never plays.
